IncidentTitle: [FlexConsumption][Http] Http Organic Traffic Failures (> 5 subs impacted in last hour)
DefaultHumanInterventionLoop: App Service (Web Apps)/Antares Functions FlexConsumption Loop

KustoQueries.title: Get_ImpactedSites
KustoQueries.kustoQuery: let _endTime = now();let _lookBackInterval = 1h;let _startTime = _endTime-_lookBackInterval;let stampName = <STAMP_NAME>;let sites = (FunctionsPlatformLogs| where PreciseTimeStamp between (_endTime-5h .. _endTime)| where EventPrimaryStampName in (flexConsumptionStamps)| distinct SiteName);let ImpactedSites = AntaresIISLogFrontEndTable| where PreciseTimeStamp between (_startTime .._endTime )| where EventPrimaryStampName==stampName| where S_sitename in (sites)| where Cs_uri_stem !startswith "admin"| summarize TotalRequests = count(), FailedRequests = countif(Sc_status >500 and (ServerRouted == '-' or isempty(ServerRouted))) by bin(PreciseTimeStamp,5min), SubscriptionId, EventPrimaryStampName, S_sitename| extend AvailabilityPercentage = 100.0 - round((FailedRequests * 100.0) / TotalRequests, 2)| where AvailabilityPercentage < 99.95 and TotalRequests > 50| where SubscriptionId != '-' // Ignore invalid subscriptionId| summarize SitesImpacted = count() by bin(PreciseTimeStamp,5min), CorrelationId= EventPrimaryStampName, SubscriptionId, S_sitename| summarize ContinuousSiteImpacted = count() by S_sitename, SubscriptionId, CorrelationId| where ContinuousSiteImpacted >3 | project S_sitename;ImpactedSites

KustoQueries.title: Get_ImpactedSites_Availability
KustoQueries.kustoQuery: let _endTime = now();let ImpactedSites= dynamic(['a', 'b', 'c']);let _lookBackInterval = 1h;let _startTime = _endTime-_lookBackInterval; let stampName = <STAMP_NAME>| AntaresIISLogFrontEndTable| where PreciseTimeStamp between (_startTime .._endTime )| where EventPrimaryStampName==stampName| where S_sitename in (ImpactedSites)| where Cs_uri_stem !startswith "/admin"| summarize TotalRequests = count(), FailedRequests = countif(Sc_status >500 and (ServerRouted == '-' or isempty(ServerRouted))) by EventPrimaryStampName, S_sitename| extend AvailabilityPercentage = 100.0 - round((FailedRequests * 100.0) / TotalRequests, 2)| where AvailabilityPercentage < 99.95 and TotalRequests > 20

MitigationInstructions: Step 1 - Find the timestamp when incident is fired.
Step 2 - Identify the stamp name STAMP_NAME that has been impacted.
Step 3 - Use the Kusto Primary Query provided in the Incident discussion entries to check the current failures.

- To run the primary query, Use Kusto cluster name from the incident discussion entries in primary kusto query execution except for FlexConsumptionDashboardClusterStampMapping table in query, for FlexConsumptionDashboardClusterStampMapping use cluster from the query itself.

Step 4 - Run this primary kusto query every hour after incident is created for 3 Iterations by updating _endTime Variable in kusto query. For example: If Incident is created at 8 AM, _endTime variable will be for 3 iterations 9 AM, 10 AM and 11 AM and follow below logic to execute query
- If current time is more than 3 hours from Incident Created Date, execute all 3 iterations together
- Otherwise run kusto query every hour from Incident Creation
Step 5 - If no result is found in all 3 iterations for the Incident Stamp, Post the details of your findings in the ICM incident in tabular format.
Step 5 - Check for Availability of Impacted Sites for Subsequent Intervals, if their availability recovering after Incident Creation, To do so, follow below steps
- To get impacted sites, Run Kusto Query Get_ImpactedSites and update _endTime Variable Value to Incident Creation Time
- To Determine Impacted sites availability after Incident Creation, Prepare Query as below
- Get Kusto Query named Get_ImpactedSites_Availability, update Variable named ImpactedSites value to list of Impacted Sites and update variable STAMP_NAME

- Execute above Get_ImpactedSites_Availability Query after updating ImpactedSites, STAMP_NAME and _endTime Variable every hour after incident is created for 3 Iterations by updating _endTime Variable in kusto query. For example: If Incident is created at 8 AM, _endTime variable will be for 3 iterations 9 AM, 10 AM and 11 AM and follow below logic to execute query
- Post discussion for query execution results in tabular format for all Iterations
Step 6 - If no results are found for Query Get_ImpactedSites_Availability in Step 4 and Kusto Primary Query in Step 3 for minimun Iterations
- then mark the incident as Mitigated  and update ICM fields How fixed as Transient
- If results are found then transfer the incident for Human Intervention and Upgrade to Sev 25
